````text
# #3630: CI: daily super run failed
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

[super run 42664754927](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42664754927) on `staging` (`3f8896c`, workflow_dispatch) failed:

| Job | Result |
|---|---|
| [e2e component (chrome)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42664754927/job/129328348208) | failure |
| [web (audio, fx, asset and daily tests)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42664754927/job/129328348267) | failure |

Each link opens that job's log. This issue stays open while the run is red and the next run that passes every job closes it. `gh workflow run super.yml --ref <branch>` runs it again on demand.

What the logs show:

- `web (audio, fx, asset and daily tests)`, two failures:
  - `src/fx/cards/meditative.test.ts` > R2784000 #2796 > **R202 #2796 a hidden play keys no entry**: `meditative-049-1 summoned: expected { cues: [ …(13) ] } to be null`.
  - `src/fx/cards/meditative/signatures.test.ts` > R3405001 > **R202 from the opponent's seat no beat names a card or shows a face**: `meditative-049-1: expected true to be false`.

  Both say a card the opponent cannot see still gets an animation entry that names it or shows its face (R202).
- `e2e component (chrome)`, four failing:
  - `classicplus-046 Legendary: expected [ 'none', 'none' ] to deeply equal [ 'full-art-drift', 'full-art-sweep' ]`;
  - `expected [ Array(18) ] to have a length of 20 but got 18`;
  - a `cy.trigger()` that timed out after 4000 ms.

Production hasn't moved since 2026-11-06: #3327 waits on a green run, as #3023 says. The daily runs of 2026-11-07 and 2026-11-08 failed on other jobs; #3439 fixed 2026-11-08's (#3456, closed 2026-11-09 07:58). `staging` has since moved to `2f21b57`, so check whether `main` still fails these before fixing them.

Night bot: this run is on `staging`, so it is yours, and it comes first (`priority:high`, and you take it before every other queued item): production promotes itself only from a daily run on `staging` that passes every job, so it waits on this fix. The fix lands on `main` like any other, and promote-staging.yml brings it to `staging` within two hours; the next daily run there that passes promotes it, or a `/promote` on the production issue tests staging's newer commit sooner. Root-cause each failed job from its log and fix it in a pull request: a flake is not a root cause, so make a flaky test robust instead of re-running it, and never skip, disable or quarantine a test to get green. Reproduce it with the job's own command (CLAUDE.md, Commands; one fuzz seed is `cargo jackioh fuzz --from <seed> --seeds 1`, with `--handicap` for the handicapped wave and `--duos` for the Duos wave; a daily test is `cargo test -p <crate> <name> -- --ignored`). A pull request's CI runs only the e2e smoke specs and leaves the tests marked `#[ignore = "daily: …"]` out, so say in the pull request which job here the fix makes pass and how you checked it. You cannot change `.github/`: make the part of the fix that lives elsewhere, and when the rest needs a workflow or an action, give the exact lines to change there and ask a person to make them.

## Plan

_Written by `claude-1` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42776865043)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Make every job of the daily super run green: `web (audio, fx, asset and daily tests)` and `e2e component (chrome)`. I reproduced both jobs on current `main` (`b050f7f5ca`) with the jobs' own commands:

- **The two meditative R202 failures are already fixed.** #3509 (`a9475a47c6`) fixed `R202 #2796 a hidden play keys no entry` and `R202 from the opponent's seat…`, and both pass on `main`. Do not touch them.
- **`web-extra` still fails on `main` for two other tests.** Cards gained table entries in the Classic+/Core signature passes, and these two tests assumed some cards had none. Fix: `src/fx/cardFx.test.ts` ("R3332000 a Field Spell's own entrance plays…") and `src/fx/entrances.test.ts` ("R670 a plain Legendary still gets the rarity entrance").
- **`e2e component` fails for three root causes.** All three are test or fixture bugs. Each fix below was applied locally, passed, and was reverted.
  - `full-art-tiers.cy.tsx`: `classicplus-046 Legendary … 'none'`.
  - `fx-phone-frame.cy.tsx` R3342000: the tile-aura count (`Array(17)` locally, `Array(18)` in CI).
  - `card-fullscreen.cy.tsx` R3351000: the `cy.trigger()` timeout.

No production code changes. No ruling is added, because no rules decision is made.

## Files to touch

| File | | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/fx/cardFx.test.ts` | change | In the R3332000 Field Spell test (about lines 330–355), "no entrance of its own" uses a table without `classicplus-078`. |
| `apps/web/src/fx/entrances.test.ts` | change | In the R670 plain-Legendary test (about line 127), use a defId that is in no table. |
| `apps/web/src/test/tileBoard.ts` | change | `tileBoardView()` cycles `eligibleUnits` over the five zones per side, as it already does for `eligibleFields`. |
| `e2e/cypress/component/full-art-tiers.cy.tsx` | change | The "with motion allowed…" test runs one card at a time. |
| `e2e/cypress/component/card-fullscreen.cy.tsx` | change | The long-press loop's hand-card triggers pass `force: true`. |

**Must not touch:** `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `.claude/`, `crates/*`, `spec/`, `apps/web/src/cards/motionSlots.ts` and its constants (`COSMETIC_FOIL_ANIMATED_MAX`), and any other production source. Governing rulings: R3340000 (motion slots), R3342000 (tile auras), R3351000, R3332000, R670. All of them are cited only in existing test names, so keep those names intact.

## Steps

1. **`apps/web/src/fx/cardFx.test.ts`**, test "R3332000 a Field Spell's own entrance plays as it lands face up and the shared Legendary entrance yields".
   - Replace `expect(entranceKeyOf(FIELD)).toBeUndefined();` with:
     ```ts
     const bare = new Map(FX_CARD_TABLE);
     bare.delete(FIELD);
     expect(entranceKeyOf(FIELD, bare)).toBeUndefined();
     ```
     This is the same pattern as the R3407000 test below it.
   - Change `entranceCues(entry, env, D).map(…)` to `entranceCues(entry, env, D, bare).map(…)`.
   - Rewrite the comment above `FIELD` so it no longer claims "R3402000: Combo-Index…". It should say the shipped table now gives Claude's Datacenter its own entrance (`obeliskRise`), so the shared Legendary entrance is checked against a table without it.
   - `FX_CARD_TABLE` is already imported at line 19.

2. **`apps/web/src/fx/entrances.test.ts`**, test "R670 a plain Legendary still gets the rarity entrance".
   - Every catalog card (774 of 774) now has a table entry, and every Legendary Unit and Field Spell has an entrance, so no real card can stand for "plain".
   - Replace the Mommy Barker line and its comment with:
     ```ts
     // The rarity's shared entrance (cues.ts `summon`) plays for a Legendary the table has no entrance for: no
     // shipped card is one now, so the defId is a stand-in the table does not hold.
     const NO_ENTRANCE = "legendary-with-no-entrance";
     expect(FX_CARD_TABLE.has(NO_ENTRANCE)).toBe(false);
     const cues = planAll([summoned("p1", "m1", NO_ENTRANCE)]);
     ```
   - Keep the two `expect(cues.some(…))` lines. `envOf()` returns `LEGENDARY_FACTS` for any id, so rays and the gold burst are drawn. `FX_CARD_TABLE` is already imported.

3. **`apps/web/src/test/tileBoard.ts`**: the fixture holds only 7 units that wear the tile aura (the rest got auras of their own). Each side's 5 zones were filled from `slice(0,5)` and `slice(5,10)`, so 7 units plus 10 backrow cards gave 17 tiles, not 20.
   - Next to `fieldsAt`, add:
     ```ts
     const unitsAt = (from: number): string[] =>
       eligibleUnits.length === 0 ? [] : Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, i) => eligibleUnits[(from + i) % eligibleUnits.length] ?? "");
     ```
   - Use `unitsAt(0).map(…)` for `you.units` and `unitsAt(5).map(…)` for `opponent.units`.
   - Instance ids stay unique, because they are indexed.
   - Update the comment: units cycle too, since the cards still wearing the tile aura keep shrinking.

4. **`e2e/cypress/component/full-art-tiers.cy.tsx`**, test "R2655003 with motion allowed…".
   - Cause: `motionSlots.ts` (R3340000) lets at most 6 faces move at once, Mythics first. The test mounted 6 Mythic + 6 Legendary + 6 Epic faces, so the Mythics took all 6 slots and no Legendary moved.
   - Change `Faces` to `function Faces({ width, cards = CARDS }: { width: number; cards?: readonly (typeof CARDS)[number][] })` and iterate `cards.flatMap(…)`.
   - Turn the test into a loop with one test per card:
     ```ts
     for (const card of CARDS) {
       it(`R2655003 with motion allowed the Legendary and Mythic move and the Epic holds still, and the name writes itself once (${card.id})`, () => { … });
     }
     ```
     - Mount `<Faces width={170} cards={[card]} />`.
     - Keep both existing assertion blocks, with `const { id } = card;` replacing their `for (const { id } of CARDS)` loops (drop the loops, not the assertions).
     - Add a comment: a card's three tiers use 2 of the 6 slots, and mounting all six cards at once starves the Legendaries.
   - Leave the other tests (layout at 3 widths, Reduce motion) untouched.

5. **`e2e/cypress/component/card-fullscreen.cy.tsx`**, test "R3351000 a long press opens inspect…".
   - Cause: the 10-card hand on a 390 px phone is a tight fan, so `hand-card-fx-h1` is covered by `h2` and Cypress refuses to trigger on it.
   - The events go to the card element itself, so `force` only skips Cypress's coverage check. Every assertion stays.
   - In the loop, add `force: press.testid.startsWith("hand-")` to the options of the `pointerdown` trigger and of the non-fullscreen branch's `pointerup` trigger. The `cy.window().trigger("pointerup", …)` call is unchanged. Add a one-line comment: the fan's cards overlap, so a hand card's centre is another card's.

## Tests

No new tests; these five edits repair existing ones. Run from the repository root:

- `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh` (first, since `src/wasm/pkg` is generated).
- `cd apps/web && JACKIOH_DAILY=1 pnpm exec vitest run --project web src/audio/ src/fx/ src/cards/art/convention.test.ts src/net/promote-production.test.ts src/net/promote-staging.test.ts src/tutorial/scripts/`. This is the job's command, and `src/fx/` should now be fully green.
- `cd e2e && pnpm exec cypress run --component --browser chrome --spec cypress/component/full-art-tiers.cy.tsx,cypress/component/card-fullscreen.cy.tsx,cypress/component/fx-phone-frame.cy.tsx`.
  - Expected: 10, 7 and 30 passing.
  - `fx-phone-frame` takes about 75 s; all 30 of its tests should pass.
- `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/test apps/web/src/fx e2e` and `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`. The `e2e` spec files are type-checked by eslint/tsc, so check the `cards` prop typing.

## Done when

- [ ] The two `src/fx` vitest tests pass, and the whole `web-extra` command is green.
- [ ] `full-art-tiers`, `card-fullscreen` and `fx-phone-frame` pass in Chrome.
- [ ] No `.skip`, `.only`, `#[ignore]`, `eslint-disable` or `@ts-*` comments were added, no test was deleted, and no timeout was raised.
- [ ] Checks that apply: `cargo fmt --check`, eslint and typecheck. `spec check`, clippy and the cargo tests are unaffected, since no Rust or spec file changes.
- [ ] The PR body states which jobs the fixes address and how they were checked:
  - `web (audio, fx, asset and daily tests)`: the vitest command above.
  - `e2e component (chrome)`: the three specs run in Chrome above.
  - Neither job runs on a pull request, so the next green daily run on `staging` is the real confirmation.

## Risks

- **The tiles fixture will keep shrinking.** `tileBoardView` depends on how many Legendary/Mythic cards lack their own aura, and now 7 do. Cycling makes it hold until that reaches 0; at 0 the 20-tile assertion fails and the test needs a fresh premise. Mention this in the comment.
- **`force: true` is limited to hand cards.** Board faces keep their real coverage check.
- **The fake-Legendary id in the entrances test must stay out of the table.** The `FX_CARD_TABLE.has(...)` assertion guards that.
- **The passes are one commit behind staging.** `staging` has since moved (`2f21b57`, and `main` has moved on again), so a card could change under these tests before the next daily. All fixes avoid naming a real card's table status.

## Open questions

- **Cypress failures I could not match to the issue.** The issue says four e2e failures but lists three. Locally, three more specs fail deterministically on `main`, and I did not fix them:
  - `fx-phone-living-game.cy.tsx` (4 tests): "expected 2 to be above 4" under 4x throttling.
  - `grant-reveals.cy.tsx` (4 tests): the grant scene never clears, or `pack-takeover` is never found.
  - `pack-opening.cy.tsx` (3 tests): `pack-takeover` measures 0×0 ("not visible"). No CSS for `.pack-takeover` turned up.
  - Their link to the run is unclear. I suspect the sandbox's slow frames trip the R3351000 shed, or the CI job never failed them. The log in the issue is truncated.
  - The builder should run these three specs once and note whether they fail identically before and after its change. Fix them only if the PR's CI or the next daily run shows them red, with the CI log as evidence. I cannot see the CI log from here.
- Because of that, a fourth CI failure may remain after this PR. If the next daily run is still red, the issue stays open and the remaining job logs will name it.
````
